mechanisms: Finished-frame matching by type and distance: the hands' UnitFinished handler takes any finished frame of the same type within 250 of a builder's started build as that builder's (crates/bot/src/brain/pianist/mod.rs, unchanged since the game), so the commander's solar finishing 224 away promoted constructor_3904's queued step; the blocked-site watchdog then stopped the builder while it was still building, because its own 97% frame stood 208 from the queued site, past the 200 exemption. Matching the finish by the frame's unit id, and exempting a builder whose own frame is still rising, would have kept armsolar_8043 (152 metal).

The pick swapping one generator for the other: H-HANDS-STARTED lets a pick of another type replace a started build. The packet's 'with the energy line STALLING, an armsolar at home; otherwise with energy under half, an armadvsol at home' changed answer each time the energy store crossed zero, so Jev swapped a started solar for an advanced solar beside the builder, and back. That lost armadvsol_3273, armsolar_25530, armsolar_10959 and armadvsol_20119 (62 metal), plus 8 never-started orders (constructor_31474's five, constructor_31726's two, constructor_25385's one). Not offering the other generator 'beside itself' while a builder's generator frame stands would have kept all four.

A list headed by stop drops whatever is being built when it lands. In a real-time game that is seconds after the report the player read: armsolar_14870 (19 metal) was begun by the pick 3 s before the stop landed and was never in a report, and armadvsol_23255 (63 metal) was dropped knowingly to clear the plant's exit lane, where the pick had begun it. 82 metal.
other_findings: Two advanced vehicle plants for one id (#avp1): the 14:13 queue put 'armavp #avp1' on six constructors' lists, all six began on the same tick (14:36), and the engine placed the orders at three sites 100-200 apart. constructor_540 began plant 16012 (14:46) and constructor_7444 began plant 20158 (14:51); both finished (17:50, 17:56): a second 2,600-metal plant, built with the metal store at 0 from 14:30 to 17:10. This is the same-tick id race fixed on 2026-10-12 (heuristics.md H-HANDS-LISTS, lists::nearest_first / same_tick_help); this game was played on 2026-10-09, before the fix.

The abandoned-frame report line gives the share at destruction, not the share the frame reached: armsolar_8043, abandoned at 98%, was reported as 'abandoned an unfinished armsolar (0% built)'. 5 of the 8 decayed frames reached the player only as that tally line, without a cell or the hands' 'abandoned ... at <cell>' line. A frame killed by an unseen raid (armllt_17620, D4) was reported as 'abandoned'.

The 9:00 list of four plain 'armsolar' steps for constructor_540 was taken as done, one step a second (9:07-9:10), by the one solar it was walking to. Since e9f5175 (2026-10-16) the first such step waits for the frame instead.
unread: Nothing torn. Tool caveats: run/frames.py measures 'never started' from the build command's coordinates, not the placed event's site, so 6 of its 35 are false positives (orders the engine placed 330-740 away, which then started); together with 5 id helpers that merged into frames begun by other builders, 11 of the 35 are not items. run/floor.py prints aband 8, which equals frames.py's decayed count; its aband_m of 15 uses the last share sampled after decay, while frames.py puts 334 metal into those same 8 frames. hands_window printed no menu lines for the builders, so the menus and gate ratings were read from jev-0.jsonl directly (pass / worlds_gate / plan rows). One seat only, so no symlink directory was needed.
